description: W8b+A6 follow-up to the tau-dictionary hauptmodul validator. TASK 1: the nome dictionary's t5 ~ 1.7e-31 is factored EXACTLY through the Fricke chart: t5(iy) = 125*qt*(1 + 6qt + 27qt^2 + 98qt^3 + ...), qt = exp(-2pi/(5y)) = exp(-4pi^2/(5 ln q0)) at the nome dictionary — integer coefficients from exact series arithmetic, verified to >= 60 digits at both q0 pins: the map is a cusp-0 chart, exponentially cusp-suppressed (theorem-level, not a numeric accident). TASK 2: natural bar<->Fricke candidates (falsifier-first, zero free parameters): the W5-fixed point has t5 = +5*sqrt(5) exactly; the bar<->Fricke-equivariant circle family tau(q0) = e^{i(pi/2 - ln q0)}/sqrt5 satisfies tau(1/q0) = W5(tau(q0)) exactly but the PROVED invariant |t5| = 5*sqrt(5) != 10 on the whole W5-fixed circle excludes the family; sign invariant: real nome => sign t5 = sign(nome), so t5 = -10 requires the odd-nome half-period chart Re tau = 1/2 mod 1 — every purely-imaginary dictionary is excluded, every half-shifted variant acquires t5 < 0 but none lands on -10 (spin-twisted nome: t5 = -7.6e-7). 10/10 gated candidates FAIL, verdicts pin-stable; no proposal. TASK 3: BN12/BDH22 printed spin data re-verified exactly (M order 5 symplectic, SNF diag (1,...,1,5,5), K_Q 2N-torsion SHARPENED to exactly 5-torsion via the 5-eigenvector (1,-2,-2,1); unique invariant characteristic Delta = 3a+b-c is EVEN (= Szego divisor, the theta-frame origin); the briefing's 'odd characteristic' framing corrected). Audit-only; NO FIT; nothing wired.

task2_exact_structure.n5h_nome_identity: the spin-twisted nome dictionary tau = -1/2 + i ln(q0)/(2pi) has modular nome exactly -1/q0
